title: napkin script 1, the object form
description: A script as JSON: an array of instructions, each an object naming its verb. Generated from the verb table by npm run api-docs; validateScript is the full check.

expression.description: An expression, its source without the parentheses: { "expr": "20 + i * 40" }.

color.description: A CSS color: a name, #rgb to #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl() or hsla().

position.description: Where a parsed instruction came from. A program building JSON leaves it out.

napkin.title: napkin
napkin.description: The language version the script was written for. The first line of a script; without it version 1 is assumed, with a warning.

page.title: page
page.description: The page size: a named size (a3, a4, a5, letter, legal, tabloid, square, slide, napkin) or a width and a height, turned portrait or landscape.

background.title: background
background.description: The page color, or none for a transparent page.

anyOf.description: A CSS color: a name, #rgb to #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl() or hsla().

name.title: name
name.description: The page's name, and the file stem it is written under.

units.title: units
units.description: The unit bare numbers are read in from here on: px, in, mm or pt. Pixels until changed.

seed.title: seed
seed.description: The seed for the hand-drawn pass. One script and one seed draw the same bytes every run.

newpage.title: newpage
newpage.description: Starts another page the same size, carrying the paint state across.

layer.title: layer
layer.description: A drawing layer. Marks after it go on it until the next layer.

group.title: group
group.description: A group layer. The layer and group lines in its block become its children.

tool.title: tool
tool.description: The kind of mark: pen, marker (translucent, so overlapping passes build up like ink), copic (a broad, angled nib) or eraser (takes away what is under it, on its own layer only).

color.title: color
color.description: The ink color of every mark after it.
A CSS color: a name, #rgb to #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl() or hsla().

width.title: width
width.description: The stroke width of every mark after it.

opacity.title: opacity
opacity.description: The opacity of every mark after it, from 0 to 1.

fill.title: fill
fill.description: The fill color of closed shapes after it, or none.

anyOf.description: A CSS color: a name, #rgb to #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl() or hsla().

gradient.title: gradient
gradient.description: A gradient fill for closed shapes after it: linear at an angle, or radial from the centre out, or none.

stroke.title: stroke
stroke.description: Turns the outline on or off. With it off, a closed shape is its fill alone.

style.title: style
style.description: The outline's dash: solid, dashed or dotted.

profile.title: profile
profile.description: How the width runs along a pen or marker stroke: uniform, rounded, tapered or wave.

nib.title: nib
nib.description: The angle of the copic nib, in degrees.

rough.title: rough
rough.description: The hand-drawn pass for every mark after it: 0 is exact, 1 is clearly drawn by hand, and off is 0. Seeded, so it draws the same way every run.

font.title: font
font.description: The font family and size of text after it.

rect.title: rect
rect.description: A rectangle, with rounded corners when r is given.

circle.title: circle
circle.description: A circle, drawn as four cubic curves rather than a polygon.

ellipse.title: ellipse
ellipse.description: An ellipse, from its centre and two radii.

line.title: line
line.description: A straight line between two points.

polygon.title: polygon
polygon.description: A closed shape through a list of points, with rounded corners when r is given.

polyline.title: polyline
polyline.description: An open line through a list of points.

star.title: star
star.description: A star with the given number of points, between an outer and an inner radius.

arc.title: arc
arc.description: An open arc of a circle between two angles, in degrees clockwise from three o'clock.

spiral.title: spiral
spiral.description: A spiral winding out from its centre to the radius over the given number of turns.

shape.title: shape
shape.description: A named shape from the built-in library, drawn in a box from x, y. With one size its longer side is that long and it keeps its proportions; with a width and a height it is stretched to fill them.

path.title: path
path.description: One mark, from SVG path data or from a block of path steps. Each subpath of a compound path is one piece of the same mark.

move.title: move
move.description: Starts a new subpath at a point.

to.title: to
to.description: A straight segment to a point.

by.title: by
by.description: A straight segment by an offset from the current point.

curve.title: curve
curve.description: A cubic curve to a point, steered by two handles.

smooth.title: smooth
smooth.description: A cubic curve whose first handle mirrors the last one, so the join stays smooth.

through.title: through
through.description: A smooth curve through a list of points. Inside a path block it continues the subpath; outside one it is an open mark of its own.

close.title: close
close.description: Closes the current subpath back to its start.

push.title: push
push.description: Saves the transform, the paint state and the units, for the next pop to restore.

pop.title: pop
pop.description: Restores the transform, the paint state and the units the last push saved.

rotate.title: rotate
rotate.description: Turns everything drawn after it, clockwise in degrees, about the origin or a point given with at.

scale.title: scale
scale.description: Scales everything drawn after it, about the origin or a point given with at. One factor scales both ways.

mirror.title: mirror
mirror.description: Reflects everything drawn after it: x swaps left and right across a vertical line, y swaps top and bottom across a horizontal one, at 0 unless given.

let.title: let
let.description: Names a number for the expressions after it, in the current units.

define.title: define
define.description: Records a block of drawing under a name without drawing it, for place to draw.

place.title: place
place.description: Draws a definition, moved, scaled or turned.

repeat.title: repeat
repeat.description: Runs a block a number of times, counting from 0 in the name given with as.

text.title: text
text.description: A text item, measured and aligned, and editable in the app. With as marks the letters are drawn as pen strokes instead.

image.title: image
image.description: Places an image: an asset the host supplied, by name, or a data URL. Nothing is read from disk.

link.title: link
link.description: Places a linked file: one selectable element that references the file instead of drawing its contents into the page.

use.title: use
use.description: Copies in a document the host supplied, as a group, with its layers and anchors.

effect.title: effect
effect.description: An effect for the next layer, group or mark the script makes, as its CSS filter function works: blur, brightness, contrast, saturate, grayscale, sepia, invert, hue-rotate, opacity or drop-shadow. Several stack in order, and none clears what is waiting.

anyOf.description: A CSS color: a name, #rgb to #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl() or hsla().

crop.title: crop
crop.description: The box every output is cut to: auto fits the ink with room to spare, none keeps the page, or a box given outright.

registration.title: registration
registration.description: One box every page is written in, so frames drawn by one script line up when they are played in sequence.
